findings.evidence: The current structured review outcome does not separately preserve human judgments for publisher officiality, revision currentness, and redistribution/use rights; source metadata remains UNREVIEWED.
findings.proposedCorrection: Define a bounded external pilot ledger or narrowly scoped schema that records each document-level judgment independently before real intake begins.

findings.evidence: The current structured reason taxonomy cannot independently record table-structure, product-variant, condition-dimension, project-stage, comparison/tolerance, or duration-semantic loss.
findings.proposedCorrection: Add bounded pilot-ledger fields or reason codes for each required loss mode before real-document scoring.

inputBlockers.evidence: The fixed repository-root evidence-inbox directory, manifest, and normalized source bundles were absent.
No real candidate review decision, review duration, usefulness result, or repository-review suitability judgment was supplied.

methodologyRisks: URL shape and hashes establish bounded identity and stability, not publisher officiality, currentness, technical truth, applicability, or legal use rights.
Normalized page-text quote binding does not prove fidelity to the original PDF page, table structure, or printed locator.
The runtime decision and patch artifacts do not preserve a complete rejected/deferred candidate ledger, human timing, or usefulness metrics.
A real audit PASS can coexist with BLOCKED_INPUT_MISSING and must not be treated as Gate B success.
One intake is capped at 10 documents; an 11-12 document pilot needs predeclared multi-batch deduplication or a cap of 8-10.
Reviewed-suggestion precision must measure semantic source support, separately from repository-review approval yield.
Conflict and supersession accuracy require a human gold list of expected material relationships.
The pilot needs a separate bounded ledger for per-document authenticity, revision-currentness, redistribution/use disposition, and every candidate decision.
nextActionOwnerOnly: Do not begin the real-document pilot. A separate explicitly scoped change must first provide a bounded ledger/schema for document validity, original-source fidelity, every candidate decision, loss modes, timing, usefulness, conflicts, supersessions, and patch suitability.
decisionReason: Fewer than eight valid official documents and no human candidate decisions exist, and the current review artifacts cannot preserve every required document-validity and electrical-evidence loss judgment; real-document metrics cannot be computed without fabrication.
nonClaims: Synthetic evaluation and audit success do not establish real-document utility, authenticity, currentness, or legal use rights.
No real source is classified as official from a hostname, URL, hash, sourceClass, or synthetic fixture.
Normalized page text and a thin patch do not preserve or replay original PDF table geometry or other layout-dependent meaning.
No claim was automatically VERIFIED or customer-use ALLOWED.
No production, staging, D1, endpoint, log, secret, customer-data, scraping, CRM, outreach, email, LLM, or automation action occurred.
